# Research management review template

Procedure: [RSI management handoff](../operations/recursive-research.md#research-management).
This is a derived review, not a replacement for original plans or execution journals.

## Scope frozen before review

Program/parent ID; evidence root and manifest/hash; expected work IDs; review owner;
verification commands/time bound; financial budget; source availability; previous
inspected evidence and unresolved completeness limitations.

## Work register

| Work ID / owner | Contract / evidence | Actual budget use / original bound | Delivery / evidence / readiness | Dependency / blocker | Lesson / next action |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

Link successful, failed, abandoned, missing and partial outputs. Treat retries as
consumed reservations. Separate repeated test executions from unique test cases.
Use `unknown` for missing proof and `not applicable` for unmeasured financial metrics.

## Reconciliation and decisions

Hash/identity checks; reservation/result agreement; missing or contradictory evidence;
retained warnings; exact scientific disposition source; unchanged incumbent;
comparison eligibility and evaluation independence. Scientific judgement stays with
[GRS](../research-standard.md), not an administrative completion score.

## Next bounded proposal

One question, accountable role, dependencies, fixed change, finite attempt/time limits,
acceptance/failure criteria and required handoff. State proposed versus authorized
versus launched. Link portfolio priority decisions to the existing roadmap owner.

## Closure

Actual commands/exits and artifact hashes; changes to navigation; preserved originals;
remaining limitations; lesson and next review condition. An inventory is only as
complete as its declared inputs and is not execution authority.


### Leaderboard reconciliation

Apply the [closure contract](../operations/recursive-research.md#leaderboard-closure-contract):
canonical owner path; cycle/case/context IDs; Calmar headline with evidence status,
CAGR, drawdown and time underwater per the scoring contract; tags; qualified or unranked status;
source/receipt and lesson; retained failures; upsert or verified no-change;
before/after hashes and validation; pending blocker if unavailable. Exactly one
leaderboard table; no duplicate strategy for a retry or cached control. This field
is required for completed research cycles, including negative/synthetic closures.
